docs.s: If you have never installed a CK3 mod
docs.x: New to this On Steam it is genuinely one click. Open the Workshop page, hit Subscribe, and the next time you open the Paradox launcher the mod is in your list waiting to be added to a playset. Nothing to unzip and nothing to configure. Off Steam — GOG, Epic, Game Pass — it is about five minutes of copying a folder and writing one small text file by hand. Both of my mods have a page that walks the whole thing: The Long Night and Supernatural . The part that trips up almost everyone is not installing a mod. It is the load order. CK3 resolves conflicts by letting the mod lower in your playset overwrite the one above it, which means a mod that appears to do nothing is usually being overwritten rather than being broken, and sorting two incompatible mods rather than disabling one of them leaves you running a mixture of both. I wrote up the whole thing — load order, what a game patch does to a mod, finding the one bad mod out of forty, and how to read the error log — on a separate page: when CK3 mods break . It applies to any mod, not just mine.

docs.t: Download Supernatural — CK3 mod without Steam
docs.x: Manual install Download without Steam Supernatural is plain files, so it runs on any copy of Crusader Kings III: GOG, Epic, Game Pass, wherever you bought it. It takes about ten minutes by hand, and this page walks the whole thing. Home › Mods › Supernatural › Download If your CK3 is on Steam, use the Workshop instead It's one click, it keeps itself current, and it handles the load order for you. Nothing on this page is better; it exists for people who can't use the Workshop at all. Subscribe on the Steam Workshop → Step zero Get the files The mod is open source. The repository is the download, with no mirror, no shortener and no waiting. Download from GitHub Browse the source current release on GitHub CK3 1.20 no other mods required free, forever On the newest release, take Source code (zip) under Assets. The .tar.gz is the same files in a wrapper Windows can't open on its own, so stick with the zip. Still on CK3 1.19? Take v2.35a , the last version built for 1.19. That is the one to use with A Game of Thrones until AGOT is updated for 1.20. Fair warning about the size. Supernatural is a large mod. The art alone is a few hundred megabytes, so expect a download in that range rather than a quick one. That is the mod itself, not padding, and it is the same weight the Workshop copy takes up on your disk. Ten minutes Installing it by hand Unzip it The archive holds one folder named after the version, something like CK3SupernaturalMod-2.38 . Open it. That outer folder is only packaging and is not what goes into your game. Inside are the two things you need, sitting side by side: supernatural_mod : the mod folder, containing common , events , gfx , gui , history , localization , music and descriptor.mod supernatural_mod.mod : a small text file the launcher reads You need both . A handful of .txt changelogs and .py helper scripts sit inside the mod folder as well. They're leftovers from building it; the game ignores them, and you can leave them exactly where they are. Move both into your CK3 mod directory The folder and the .mod file go here together, and the .mod file sits next to the folder, never inside it: Windows Documents\Paradox Interactive\Crusader Kings III\mod\ macOS ~/Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/ Linux ~/.local/share/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/ If there's no mod folder there yet, launch CK3 once and close it, or create the folder yourself. Replace the .mod file (don't skip this one) This is the step that decides whether any of the rest works, and it is not optional . The supernatural_mod.mod file inside the download was written on my computer, and it still carries the folder path from my computer. On your machine that path doesn't exist, so the launcher reports a descriptor error and the mod never shows up. Open supernatural_mod.mod in any plain text editor (Notepad is fine), select everything, delete it, and paste this in its place: copy version="2.38" picture="thumbnail.png" tags={ "Alternative History" "Gameplay" "Events" "Character Interactions" } name="Supernatural" supported_version="1.20.*" path="mod/supernatural_mod" Two things changed, and both matter. path= is now relative : it says "the supernatural_mod folder inside mod ", which is true on every machine. And the remote_file_id line is gone : that line tells the launcher "this is a Steam Workshop item", which is exactly what your copy isn't, and leaving it in is a good way to have the launcher ignore your folder or replace it. Make sure your editor saves it as supernatural_mod.mod and not supernatural_mod.mod.txt . On Windows you may need to turn on file extensions to see the difference. Enable it and set the load order Open the Paradox launcher, go to All installed mods , and Supernatural should be listed. Add it to a playset. On its own it needs nothing above it, because it's a base-game overhaul rather than a submod. If you're also running The Long Night & Azor Ahai , the order matters and the patch goes last: A Game of Thrones (required by The Long Night) AGOT submods: AGOT+, Valyrian Steel, Submod Core, Nobility… AGOT: The Long Night & Azor Ahai Supernatural (this mod) The Compatibility Patch , always last Running it with The Long Night Two mods, one campaign Supernatural and The Long Night both rewrite some of the same base-game files, and whichever loads second overwrites the other's version without any warning. The compatibility patch exists to settle that, and it only works from the very bottom of the list. A Game of Thrones AGOT submods: AGOT+, Valyrian Steel, Submod Core, Nobility… AGOT: The Long Night & Azor Ahai Supernatural (this one) The Compatibility Patch, always last The patch is on the Workshop , and there's a full write-up of what it merges on the mods page. When it goes wrong Troubleshooting "Descriptor file error" You skipped step 3, or the path= line is still wrong. It's the cause almost every time. Use forward slashes , never backslashes, even on Windows. The path must match your folder name exactly, including case: supernatural_mod . If the relative path still won't take, use the full one instead: path="C:/Users/YourName/Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/supernatural_mod" , with your Windows username. It doesn't appear at all Check the file is .mod , not .mod.txt . Check it's in the mod folder itself, not inside the mod's own folder. Check you removed the remote_file_id line. With it left in, the launcher may look for a Workshop copy instead of yours. Restart the launcher fully; it scans on start. Confirm supernatural_mod itself contains common and events , not another folder that contains them. If you're still stuck, the Supernatural Discord is the fastest place to get it sorted; manual-install questions get answered there. Common questions Manual install FAQ Do I need any other mods for this? No. Supernatural is a base-game overhaul: it runs on Crusader Kings III on its own, with no total conversion underneath it. You only need extra pieces if you're combining it with AGOT and The Long Night, and then it's the compatibility patch, loaded last. Why do I have to edit the .mod file when the Workshop version just works? Because the Workshop writes that file for you, pointing at wherever Steam put the mod on your machine. A manual copy doesn't get that, so it ships with the path from the machine it was built on, which is mine. Step 3 replaces it with a relative path that's correct everywhere. It's one paste, and it's the difference between the mod loading and the launcher reporting an error. Will it update itself? No. A manual install is a snapshot of one version. When a new one goes out you'll want to delete the old supernatural_mod folder, unzip the new one in its place, and change the version= line in your .mod file to match. Watching the repository or joining the Discord is the easiest way to know when that happens. Can I use it with an existing save? Adding an overhaul this size to a campaign already in progress isn't something I'd promise will go cleanly. Supernatural adds traits, lifestyles and characters that a running save was never built expecting. Starting a fresh campaign is the version of this I can stand behind. If you want to try it mid-save anyway, copy your save file somewhere safe first. Does it work on Mac and Linux? It's script and assets rather than compiled code, so yes. Only the folder location differs, and both paths are in step 2. Where's the source? The repository is public , so you can read every file, open an issue, or fork it. Supernatural was built on other people's work and it seemed only right to pass that along the same way. Can I put this on my own Discord or mirror it somewhere? Please do; that's why it's public. Linking back to this page or the repository is appreciated, mostly so people end up on a version that's current rather than one frozen in 2023. Standing on other people's work. Supernatural leans on Rycie's Witchcraft mod, Nope's V&L mod, the Modjam Team's Witches & Alchemists potion-crafting interface, the Princes of Darkness team, and Luke0704's Spanish translation. If you enjoy this, that's where a lot of it started. Supernatural is a free, non-commercial fan mod for Crusader Kings III. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Paradox Interactive. While you're here What the mod does If you landed here for the download and haven't seen it, the full breakdown is worth a look : the four supernatural traits, the six lifestyles, the men-at-arms, the artifacts, and the potions. There is also a wiki covering every mechanic in the mod. And if the undead are more your thing, The Long Night & Azor Ahai has a manual install guide of its own .

docs.t: Supernatural — a CK3 (Crusader Kings III) mod by Dlonem
docs.x: A Crusader Kings III mod Super natural Vampires, werewolves, hybrids, witches, demons and the hunters who go after them, in the base game. Every creature is a character with a name and a court, every body leaves a trail, and every hunt is aimed at somebody who did something. Play the hunter, or rule as something far older. Subscribe on Steam Workshop Read the wiki Download without Steam Join the Discord Version 2.38 Updated 10 October 2026 Works with base CK3 CK3 1.20 No other mods required Free, forever Home › Mods › Supernatural 11,600+ current subscribers 53,700+ unique visitors ★★★★★ 480 ratings 1,900+ favorites Latest update · from the Steam change notes 2.38: The Hermetic Order of the Blue Rose 10 October 2026 The Hermetic Order of the Blue Rose comes to Supernatural: temples of Mages that send a note and a blue rose, tests to pass, ranks to climb, relics to pledge, and a Gnostic Council whose chair passes by Conclave. The Vade Maecum Infernal, a demon thief called Zecchia, coven panels and a war for relics come with it. Every change note on Steam → See it in game Straight from the Workshop click any shot to enlarge · screenshots hosted on Steam Core features What the mod adds The blood Vampires feed, and it can cost the county. A body, or a victim who talks, leaves it harder to hold, a shaken county is easier to feed in next time, and a bite that takes will wake a man hungry. Since 2.36 your own rite judges what you do, once it knows what you are. Refuse the blood twice and it kills him. Every vampire has a maker and every maker has progeny, and the ranks run from Fledgling to Elder. The moon, and the hybrid A werewolf's wound festers for one to three years before it turns. Werewolves rank from Fledgling to Elder, and a known hybrid frightens a court more than a known vampire does. Since 2.37 six ancient wolf hides choose Champions of their own, and wolves run in packs with an alpha, a Second and a Werewolf Gathering of their own. Six lifestyles and ten perk trees cover vampires, werewolves, hunters, hybrids, magic and demons, and the demon tree alone is seventeen perks. The hunt Since 2.35 the monsters leave trails. A kill, or a feed somebody talks about, marks the county, the lord notices, and a real hunter runs a Supernatural Hunt there: a Monster Hunt or a Witch Hunt, three weeks of tracking to work out what it is and who it is, with the creature getting its own side of every beat. Hunters train apprentices, field their own regiment, and keep a Trailsman at court who reads the countryside. Regiments and artifacts Ten men-at-arms regiments: wolves, werewolves, bats, vampires and the hunters' own trainees, plus cultists, skeleton warriors, demonic knights, battle golems and Baba Yaga's hut. Artifacts to find or make, the Ring of Everlasting, the Magic Catalyst and the Black Grimoire among them, and since 2.38 seven lesser relics and the Seal of Solomon. The craft Witches brew. One decision, Create Potion, rolls one of eleven potions, from youth and might to a mutagen that can go badly wrong. It needs a witch who is also a herbalist, the Advanced Alchemy perk, or a hunter's Combat Spells. Compulsion lets a vampire bend anyone who is not a vampire, hybrid, demon or witch. Since 2.38 the Hermetic Order of the Blue Rose keeps temples of Mages and teaches the people it calls, with relics to pledge, a Gnostic Council chosen in masks at the Conclave, and a demon's book torn into four pages. A character can now be a Mage, a Warlock or a True Witch, not two. The look of it A red main menu and eighteen loading screens, so the game looks like the mod from the moment it opens. Customize your journey Your arcane, your rules Twenty-six game rules decide how much of this touches your campaign: how traits are inherited (eight settings), how demons pass theirs down, how common the creatures are, and how hard the hunters come. Hunt it, rule with it, or leave it at the edges of the map. Two ways in Getting the mod Free either way. The Workshop is the easy one; the manual install is for anyone whose copy of CK3 didn't come from Steam. On Steam One click, it keeps itself current, and the launcher sorts it out for you. If you have the choice, take this one. Subscribe on the Workshop GOG, Epic, Game Pass The mod is plain files, so it runs on any copy of the game. Download it from the repository and drop it in by hand. It takes about ten minutes, and the guide walks every step. Download without Steam Playing it alongside The Long Night & Azor Ahai ? Both mods rewrite some of the same files, so you'll want the compatibility patch — loaded last. Credits Rycie for the Witchcraft mod Luke0704 for the Spanish translation Nope for the V&L mod The Princes of Darkness mod team, especially BDW & Sparc The people on YouTube and in the Discord who reported, argued and tested. You shaped this mod. Free, forever Supernatural is a free, non-commercial fan mod for Crusader Kings III. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Paradox Interactive. Screenshots are served from the mod's Steam Workshop page.

docs.t: Supernatural CK3 Mod Wiki: Vampires, Werewolves and the Hunt
docs.x: The wiki Supernatural wiki: the Crusader Kings III mod on one page Every mechanic in the mod, with the numbers, read from the files it ships. If someone asks in the Discord how something works, the answer is on this page, and every section has a link you can paste. Subscribe on Steam Workshop Mod page Ask in the Discord Version 2.38 CK3 1.20 Needs only the base game Updated 10 Oct 2026 Home › Mods › Supernatural › Wiki Jump to: Quick answers · Vampires · Werewolves and hybrids · Witches and demons · The hunt · Across every kind · Reference A living page. It changes with the mod and is checked against every release. This edition covers 2.38 , The Hermetic Order of the Blue Rose, on Crusader Kings III 1.20, as of 10 October 2026. What changed in each version. Start here Quick answers The questions that come up most, grouped by topic. Tap a question to open its answer; each one links to the full section. Open all Vampires How do I become a vampire? Get a vampire's blood into you, then finish the change. A vampire or hybrid can use Offer Blood and then Turn Vampire on you, or you can use Ask to be Turned on a vampire you know. Falling in battle or dying a natural death with the blood in you also turns you. Nobody is born a vampire. Every route into vampirism. Why did my county lose control after I fed? A body leaves a mark on the county it was found in, and so does a feed somebody talks about. A drained body costs 5 county control ; a feed that gets talked about costs 1. Two incidents inside a year open a trail, Something Stalks Here , and at the third the county's lord is told. Trails and what leaves them. Werewolves How do I turn someone into a werewolf, and can it be cured? A werewolf uses Offer Gift or Force Gift . That gives the Infected Wound , which lasts one to three years and ends in a turning, a reprieve or death. The cure is the Abandon Lycanthropy decision, which needs the Supernatural: Embrace Decisions rule set to On. The rule is off by default. The bite, in full. The werewolf cure. How do I get one of the six hides? Be a werewolf or hybrid whose traits suit the hide, then get hold of it. Most start as relics in shrines at holy sites. Learn where one is at a Werewolf Gathering , then hold the county, besiege it, go there on pilgrimage, or use Send for a Hide . A hide that accepts you makes you its Champion . Where the hides are. Who each hide chooses. Hunters How does a hunter find me, and what can I do about it? He follows the trail your kills leave on a county and tracks for three weeks . If his Tracking bar reaches 60 you are warned. At the door you choose an answer: fight, go to ground for two years, look him in the eye, send your progeny, let the wolf out, buy him off, or point him at a worse county. The door, from both sides. How do I play a hunter? Take the Hunter trait in the ruler designer, or use Ask to be trained as a Hunter on a hunter you know. You pick monsters or witches first, and training then takes 75 to 115 days. If it fails you become an apprentice and finish on a hunt with your trainer. The work itself is the Supernatural Hunt activity. Hunters. Riding out on a hunt. Witches, demons and mages How do I become a witch? A witch brings you in. The route is the Convert to Witchcraft scheme, which a witch runs on someone who is not one. Nobody is born a witch: what passes to children is the Source and Yaga's Blood. Becoming a witch. How do I become a demon? Take Minor Demon in the ruler designer. Otherwise there are three routes: be born to a demon with Demonic Heritage, which becomes the trait in your twenties; answer a Magic Eruption with I must harness this power at all costs ; or finish the Ascendancy special project. Becoming a demon. How do I become a mage? Mage is the capstone of the Arcane tree in the Magic lifestyle. Arcane is closed to a plain witch: it opens with a magic artifact, the Source blood, a place of power, an academy, or a house that has one. Finish the tree and the Mage trait is yours, unless you already hold Warlock or True Witch: you get one of the three. A hunter cannot take it. The Order of the Blue Rose also teaches its acolytes to be Mages. The Magic lifestyle and its trees. How do I join the Order of the Blue Rose? You are called; you cannot apply. docs.x: The questions that come up most, grouped by topic. Tap a question to open its answer; each one links to the full section. Open all Vampires How do I become a vampire? Get a vampire's blood into you, then finish the change. A vampire or hybrid can use Offer Blood and then Turn Vampire on you, or you can use Ask to be Turned on a vampire you know. Falling in battle or dying a natural death with the blood in you also turns you. Nobody is born a vampire. Every route into vampirism. Why did my county lose control after I fed? A body leaves a mark on the county it was found in, and so does a feed somebody talks about. A drained body costs 5 county control ; a feed that gets talked about costs 1. Two incidents inside a year open a trail, Something Stalks Here , and at the third the county's lord is told. Trails and what leaves them. Werewolves How do I turn someone into a werewolf, and can it be cured? A werewolf uses Offer Gift or Force Gift . That gives the Infected Wound , which lasts one to three years and ends in a turning, a reprieve or death. The cure is the Abandon Lycanthropy decision, which needs the Supernatural: Embrace Decisions rule set to On. The rule is off by default. The bite, in full. The werewolf cure. How do I get one of the six hides? Be a werewolf or hybrid whose traits suit the hide, then get hold of it. Most start as relics in shrines at holy sites. Learn where one is at a Werewolf Gathering , then hold the county, besiege it, go there on pilgrimage, or use Send for a Hide . A hide that accepts you makes you its Champion . Where the hides are. Who each hide chooses. Hunters How does a hunter find me, and what can I do about it? He follows the trail your kills leave on a county and tracks for three weeks . If his Tracking bar reaches 60 you are warned. At the door you choose an answer: fight, go to ground for two years, look him in the eye, send your progeny, let the wolf out, buy him off, or point him at a worse county. The door, from both sides. How do I play a hunter? Take the Hunter trait in the ruler designer, or use Ask to be trained as a Hunter on a hunter you know. You pick monsters or witches first, and training then takes 75 to 115 days. If it fails you become an apprentice and finish on a hunt with your trainer. The route is the Convert to Witchcraft scheme, which a witch runs on someone who is not one. Nobody is born a witch: what passes to children is the Source and Yaga's Blood. Becoming a witch. How do I become a demon? Take Minor Demon in the ruler designer. Otherwise there are three routes: be born to a demon with Demonic Heritage, which becomes the trait in your twenties; answer a Magic Eruption with I must harness this power at all costs ; or finish the Ascendancy special project. Becoming a demon. How do I become a mage? Mage is the capstone of the Arcane tree in the Magic lifestyle. docs.x: Vampirism is both the rank ladder and the currency. Compulsion and the sire bond are paid for out of the same track that names you, so a maker who leans on his progeny can fall back down a tier. Rank Vampirism What it is Fledgling Vampire under 35 The starting state for almost everyone. Vampire 35 to 70 The Vampires regiment unlocks at 50. Revered Vampire 71 to 99 Elder Vampire 100 The cap. No compulsion command needs it: the strongest, End your Life, opens at 85. On a hunt, Look them in the eye needs it unless the hunter brought silver. The numbers: what each rung of the track adds Track rungs sit at 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100, and they are cumulative, so they do not line up exactly with the rank names above. A character at 70 is called a Vampire and is carrying the rungs up to 60. Rung What it adds 20 +1 intrigue, +1 diplomacy, +8 prowess, +15% movement speed, +5% vampire lifestyle experience 40 +1 intrigue, +2 stewardship, +8 prowess, +10% movement speed, +10% experience 60 +2 intrigue, +2 stewardship, +3 learning, +9 prowess, +5% long reign bonus, +5% experience 80 +2 intrigue, +2 stewardship, +2 martial, +10 prowess, −5% dread decay, +10% experience 100 +4 intrigue, +2 stewardship, +2 martial, +2 learning, +10 prowess, +15% scheme discovery, +1 domain limit, +10% long reign bonus, +5% experience At a full track, with the base trait, that totals +13 intrigue, +10 stewardship, +6 learning, +4 martial, +1 diplomacy and +55 prowess , plus a quarter again on movement speed and a domain slot. How the track fills. Every living vampire gets +1 a year and nothing more, which is a hundred years to Elder on the drip alone. The real lever is feeding: a clean feed on the decision pays 15 to 35, a feed that ends in a kill pays the same, the traveller on the road pays 5 to 12 and blood you paid for pays 10 to 20. Surviving a hunter pays the same for every kind: 15 to 30 for beating one on a hunt, 8 to 15 for looking him in the eye, 5 to 12 for going to ground or sending him to another county, and 4 to 10 for running when you are warned. The century events pay perk points rather than track experience.

docs.s: Feeding: Satiate Thirst and the Feeding activity
docs.x: The activity header the mod ships for the Feeding activity. There are two feeding systems. The Satiate Thirst decision is the quick one: a seven-year cooldown for a player, a three-day wait, and a short event chain with three ways to go about it. The Feeding activity is the long one: you travel to a town, you can bring up to five other vampires, and it runs over about six weeks with a visible success bar. The decision offers a courtier from your own realm, a traveller on the road, or blood you buy for a little gold. Taking the courtier is the highest-paying and the riskiest: seven times in ten it goes cleanly, twice in ten the courtier dies, and once in ten you are seen and the secret starts moving. Higher Vampirism shifts weight out of both failure branches and into the clean one, so power makes you tidier as well as stronger. The activity is the set piece. It needs a province with a city or tribal holding within reach of your court, and you choose two things before you ride: Choice Cost What it does Vampire Instincts free The default. Nothing. Scout the City 25 gold +10 on the success chance. Ambush 35 gold and up +20 on the success chance. Respect the Dead free The default spoils choice. Take What You Need 20 piety Unlocks a loot option at the end worth 20 to 125 gold plus twice the county's prosperity. docs.x: Whoever's blood made you is your Sire , and you are their Progeny . The relation is asymmetric on purpose: the progeny likes the maker by +400 , the maker likes the progeny by +150 . It is set on every route in, which was not true before 2.33; a vampire made by the older paths had a sire recorded in their tooltip and no actual relation, so none of the things below worked for them. What the bond is for is Invoke the Bond , an interaction a sire can use on their progeny once every eight years. It has twenty orders and each one is paid for out of the sire's own Vampirism track, which is the whole design: leaning on your bloodline costs you rank. Order Cost Order Cost Entertain Me 5 Support my Influences 20 Demand Gold 10 Be a Fallen Hunter 20 Dismiss your Regent 10 Give me your Prisoners 20 Become my Patron 10 You Owe Me 25 Tell me your Secrets 10 Surrender your Wars 25 Release your Prisoners 10 Marry me 30 Join my Wars 15 Take my Faith 35 Become my Lover 15 Take my Culture 35 Join Me 15 Give me the Titles 40 Break your Betrothal 15 Commit Suicide 75 Refusing an order breaks the bond outright: the relation is removed from both sides and the sire picks up an opinion penalty that is also a legal reason to imprison or execute him. A sire needs at least 10 Vampirism to invoke anything at all. The bond does quieter work as well. A sire and a progeny can always invite each other to a feeding, without either of them having to hold the other's secret, because a maker knows what their progeny is. An AI creature will not sell out its own blood to a hunter. And a hybrid's death on a hunt can be remembered by two different makers, the one who gave the blood and the one who did the clawing, where a vampire's can only be remembered by one.

docs.x: Compulsion is the vampire's reach into other people's heads. The interaction is Compel Mortal ; Compulsion is the name of the perk that strengthens it. It is available to vampires and hybrids, has a six-month global cooldown and a three-month cooldown against the same person, and it works on mortals and werewolves only . Vampires, hybrids, demons and witches cannot be compelled at all. Werewolves can, and they resist hard and cost an extra 5 track experience on top of whatever you asked for. You also have to be able to reach them. The target must be in your realm, your liege's realm or a bordering one, or share a court with you, or be standing in the same place you are, or be at the same activity. A feast is a compulsion range extender. Command Needs Costs Does Become my Patron 10 10 Adds them as a contact. Landless adventurers only. Demand Gold 15 15 They pay you 100 gold. Join Me 25 15 They become your courtier. Become my Lover 25 15 Sets the lover relation. Leave Prison 20 5 Releases them from their cell. Tell me your Secrets 20 20 Reveals every secret they own to you. Do What I Say 35 35 Gives you a loyalty hook. End your Life 85 85 They die. This one leaves a body. Resistance is built from your own power, which climbs steeply with the track and climbs about sixty per cent faster again with the Compulsion perk, set against the target's will: learning resists, brave and stubborn resist hard, craven and trusting fold, and a hunter resists by −20 before you start and a further −10 for every ten points of Monster-Hunter track he has. A hunter at the top of his track is effectively immune. Two things happen afterwards. A refused compulsion hands your victim your secret if you have one. And a compulsion used in a county that carries your own trail can bury an incident, or leave a hole in the county's memory if it goes badly. Covering your own kills has the odds.

docs.x: Eight characters are placed in history as the Mikaelson family: Mikael and Esther, and their children Freja, Finn, Elijah, Niklaus, Rebecca and Kol. Esther and Freja are witches. Six of them turn on the same day in 866, and five days later Mikael founds a landless adventurer camp and takes the others into it, so the Originals start a campaign as a travelling company rather than a realm. Niklaus is the mod's one placed hybrid , and every hybrid that has ever existed in any save descends from somebody he or a player made. Mechanically, being one of them does three things: an Original at a feeding is worth +15 on the success chance, the male Originals wear no beard and no headgear, and any vampire attending a feeding with one has a four-in-five chance of a short event chain about meeting them, once per character ever.

docs.x: A werewolf is mortal. It ages and scars like anyone else. What it has against an ordinary death is fifty years of added life expectancy at a full track, twenty-five more if a hide chooses it, and thirty at full Hide Bond. Werewolf Known Werewolf True Werewolf Werewolf lifestyle The trait gives +2 martial, +2 diplomacy, +1 learning and +15 prowess before any rank, plus immunity to non-epidemic disease and +10 life expectancy . It renames itself by rank as the Lycanthropy track fills, and it is the only creature whose power reads as fighting strength first. Becoming one: the bite, the wound and birth Being clawed does not make you a werewolf. It gives you the Infected Wound , a health trait with its own Infection track that sits on you for one to three years and then resolves. The exact date is rolled the moment the wound lands, somewhere between 365 and 1,095 days out, and nothing you do moves it. While you carry it you are visibly sick. The base wound costs 0.75 health, 2 martial, 1 intrigue, 3 prowess and a slice of fertility, and it disables combat leadership outright for the whole incubation, not just the bad end of it. Each tier of the Infection track adds more on top, and the tiers rename the trait as you climb: Infected Wound, Festering Wound, Virulent Wound, Ravaging Wound, Consuming Wound. At the top rung you are carrying −2.5 health, −10 martial, −15 prowess and a fifth more stress gain. The track moves three ways. It creeps up on its own, three points a month, which over a long incubation is most of a full track. Roughly every three to four months an event fires from a pool of nine, and each one is a choice between pushing the infection down and paying for it in stress, or letting it climb and taking the comfort. And one event in that pool, The Wolf Stirs , asks you the real question: do you want this. Answering yes lowers the infection. Answering no raises it. The flag you set matters far more than the number, and this is the single most counter-intuitive thing in the chain. Some of the other events in the pool matter more than they look. A Healer's Hands is the biggest single drop available, at up to 20 points, at a 15 per cent risk that the physician works out what you are. A Hunter Grows Suspicious is where naming the werewolf who clawed you hands a hunter a named target, and is one of the ways hunts start. The Wound Worsens can take a limb. The One Who Clawed You opens a short relationship chain with the wolf who made you that can end in friendship, a lover or a soulmate. How it ends. On the appointed day The Fever Breaks fires, you pick one of up to seven stances, and the game rolls one of six outcomes against your infection level, your traits and the flags you set along the way: Outcome What happens Something More You turn, and start at 30 Lycanthropy. Grants Strong if you lack it. The Change Takes Hold You turn, and start at 10. A Hard Turning You turn at zero, plus 30 stress. The Curse Loosens Its Grip You stay human and gain Strong. A Bitter Reprieve You stay human, wounded, plus 20 stress. The Change Consumes You You die. Low infection is what buys the clean turnings; high infection feeds both the scarred reprieve and the death. Yielding forecloses the good non-turn entirely. docs.x: Five names, on the Lycanthropy track: Lycanthropy Name Under 20 Fledgling Werewolf 20 to 49 Werewolf 50 to 79 Seasoned Werewolf 80 to 99 Dread Werewolf 100 Elder Werewolf The 50 boundary is the one that matters: it is where the Werewolves regiment unlocks. Rank does not change your portrait. Before 2.38 the third and fifth ranks were Feral and Primal. The numbers: what each rung of the track adds Rungs sit at 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100 and are cumulative, so they do not line up with the rank names. A character at 70 is called a Seasoned Werewolf and is carrying the rungs up to 60. Rung What it adds 20 +8 life expectancy, +1 martial, +1 diplomacy, +7 prowess, +5% werewolf lifestyle experience, +10 dynasty opinion 40 +8 life expectancy, +1 martial, +7 prowess, +5% experience, +1 to the size cap of Wolves and Bats, −15% inbreeding chance 60 +8 life expectancy, +1 martial, +1 diplomacy, +7 prowess, +5% experience, no prowess loss from age 80 +8 life expectancy, +1 martial, +7 prowess, +5% experience 100 +8 life expectancy, +1 martial, +1 diplomacy, +7 prowess, +5% experience, +1 to the size cap of Werewolves and Vampires, +1 personal scheme, +15 powerful vassal opinion 2.38 cut the Martial the trait gives: +2 at the start and +1 a rung, where it was +3 and +2. At a full track, with the base trait, that totals +50 life expectancy, +7 martial, +5 diplomacy, +1 learning and +50 prowess , a quarter again on lifestyle experience, and an extra scheme slot. How the track fills. Every living werewolf gets +1 a year , which is a hundred years to Elder on the drip alone. The main source is Satiate Hunger , on a five-year cooldown for a player. A successful hunt pays 15 to 35, a kill 10 to 25, running the border 12 to 25, and crossing another wolf's ground 15 to 30. Turning cleanly pays 10 or 30 once. Surviving a hunter pays the same for every kind: 15 to 30 for beating one on a hunt, 8 to 15 for looking him in the eye, 5 to 12 for going to ground or sending him to another county, and 4 to 10 for running when you are warned. Twenty to twenty-five years of consistent hunting is a realistic run to the cap.

docs.x: Satiate Hunger is the decision, and it is free: no gold, no piety, no prestige. Three days later you pick a route. Hunting your own people is the high-return one and the only one with teeth in it: 70 per cent a clean hunt, 20 per cent you kill a vassal, 9 per cent you are seen and become a Known Werewolf, and 2 per cent a hunter puts a silver arrow in you . Rank shifts that in your favour: at Lycanthropy 15, 35 and 55, weight moves out of the two bad results and into the clean hunt, 30 points in all by 55. Running the border and crossing another wolf's ground are the safe options: lower experience, no death roll, a suspicious neighbour, and in the border case a prowl mark on the county.

docs.x: Werewolves and hybrids get a self-targeted Shapeshift interaction with three forms. It is free, instant, has no cooldown and no duration, so you stay in the form you chose until you choose another. The AI can never open it; the block that would tell an AI when to shift is present in the file but unreachable. Form What it gives Human Nothing. This is the absence of the other two. Half-Wolf +3 prowess, +2 martial, +2 learning, −2 diplomacy, −1 stewardship Werewolf +6 prowess, +4 martial, −4 diplomacy, −2 stewardship, and you lose your hair The full wolf form is worth a further +15 to your side of a hunt duel, which is the one place the choice has real weight. Set against that, a shapeshifted body is unmistakable: if you are killed while shifted, the corpse reads as a werewolf no matter what you actually were. What shifting does not do is change your model. There is no wolf portrait, no wolf head, no new skin. The only visible change is going bald in full wolf form, plus the modifier on your character sheet. The prowess in both forms is the kind that deliberately does not alter your portrait's build. One other thing can put you in wolf form: during a hunt, when a hunter is at your door, you can answer it as the wolf. That is the only timed shift in the mod, thirty days, and it costs you your secret with every hunter attending.

docs.x: The mod tracks who clawed whom with a pair of relations, Clawed and Clawed By . They are identifiers and nothing more: both are worth zero opinion . Compare the vampire's Sire and Progeny , worth +400 and +150. The werewolf's sentiment comes from a separate pair of permanent opinion modifiers instead: +50 grateful if the turning was voluntary, −50 resentful if it was forced. A forced victim can be linked to the wolf who made him and be his rival at the same time. Maker and get also count as kin when a hunter comes: see Who stands with the creature . Standing groups of wolves are Packs .

docs.x: Abandon Lycanthropy is a decision with no cost and no cooldown, and it takes everything: the trait, Known Werewolf, True Werewolf, all eight lifestyle perks and your secret. Since 2.37 it also ends a Champion's bond with his hide, which stays in his hands, and takes him out of his pack. It is behind the Embrace Decisions game rule, which ships off . With that rule at its default there is no cure in the game at all. The cure leaves two things behind. If you were in wolf form when you were cured you stay in wolf form, and bald, permanently. The only thing that un-shifts a werewolf is the Shapeshift interaction, and that interaction will not show for someone who is no longer a werewolf. And nothing at all removes an Infected Wound before it resolves: no decision, no interaction, no physician. Once wounded you carry the health penalty and the wait, and the wait includes a death bucket.

docs.x: Every werewolf and hybrid has a second track, Pack Standing , from 0 to 100. It decides who may found a pack, who stands Second, and who may Challenge the alpha. A wolf born to it starts at 25; a wolf made by a bite starts at nothing. A werewolf who becomes a hybrid keeps his standing. On a save from before 2.37, a wolf born to it gets his 25 the first time he founds a pack or finishes a Werewolf Gathering. What moves it Pack Standing Each year in a pack +5 A Werewolf Gathering completed +10, or +20 with the intent Earn My Place A Challenge won against a wolf who stood near you +15 A Gathering run on a rival's land +5 to everyone who came Leaving a pack −15, or −7 with Wolf Politics A Challenge lost, or turned down −10 Every gain is doubled in a pack whose alpha is Alpha's Champion. A True Alpha in a pack never sits below 75 for long: the yearly tick lifts him back up. The numbers: what Pack Standing adds Rungs at 25, 50, 75 and 100. The first adds +5 attraction opinion, +5 courtly opinion, +1 stewardship, +1 learning and +0.25 prestige a month; each of the other three adds +5 attraction opinion, +10 courtly opinion, +2 stewardship, +1 learning and +0.5 prestige a month. At 100 that totals +20 attraction opinion, +35 courtly opinion, +7 stewardship, +4 learning and +1.75 prestige a month.

docs.x: Found a Pack costs 50 prestige and needs Pack Standing 50, or 40 for a wolf born a wolf or for a hybrid with the Pack Leader perk, or 25 when another wolf at your court could run with you. A Champion can found one at any standing. An AI wolf founds a pack only with another wolf at his court or as a Champion, and invites up to three of the wolves at his court as soon as he has. You are its alpha, and the highest-standing wolf after you is your Second . Interaction or decision Who, on whom What it costs Invite to the Pack An alpha, on a wolf in no pack Nothing. You can ask the same wolf again after two years, or after one as Tundra's Champion. Ask to Run With Their Pack A wolf, on another pack's alpha If you are leaving a pack to do it: −15 standing (−7 with Wolf Politics), and −15 opinion from your old alpha for five years Lure Away An alpha with Wolf Politics or standing 75, on a wolf in another pack His old alpha thinks −25 of you for ten years. Once every five years per wolf. Leave the Pack Any wolf but the alpha −15 standing (−7 with Wolf Politics), and −15 opinion from the alpha for five years Disband the Pack The alpha Nobody loses standing. The AI never does it. You can only invite, ask or lure a wolf you know to be one: openly known, family, your spouse or a pack-mate, someone whose secret you hold, someone tied to you by the claw, or, since 2.38, a wolf at the same court. A wolf turned by a bite whose maker runs a pack with room gets An Invitation three days after he turns. Packs recruit. Each year a packless adult wolf has a 20% chance of being asked by an AI alpha with room who knows what he is, does not dislike him and is not his rival. The alpha must be his kin, or tied to him by the claw, or be within reach and either share his faith or culture or think well of him; the wolf must not think badly of the alpha either. Kin, the claw and a Champion alpha weigh more, and the same alpha asks the same wolf at most once in two years. The question comes as An Invitation . An AI wolf asks to run with another pack, or leaves his own, only for a reason: he has no pack, he and his alpha have no use for each other, or a friend or lover runs in the other. Asked with Ask to Run With Their Pack , an AI alpha whose pack has only one or two wolves is readier to say yes. When an alpha dies, the pack goes to his co-alpha if he has one, then to the highest-standing Champion in it, then to the wolf who killed him if that wolf is in the pack, and then to the highest-standing wolf left.

docs.x: Runs With a Pack : +1% werewolf and hybrid lifestyle experience and +0.5% to every lifestyle for each wolf in it, so a full pack of 25 is worth +25% and +12.5%. A pack with a True Alpha in it counts double. The Pack Mentality perk adds half as much again. Every year: +5 Pack Standing and +2 Lycanthropy, or +3 under an alpha who is a Champion, with one more for two Champions in the pack and two more for three or more. A Champion in a pack gains +5 Hide Bond a year rather than +2. Two Champions in one pack give every member Two Spirits Run Together : +2 prowess and +10% werewolf and hybrid lifestyle experience. Three or more give The Old Ones Gather : +4 prowess, +0.2 health and +20%. On a hunt, a pack-mate in the county comes through the door as kin, worth 12 off the hunter's side (see Who stands with the creature ). The pack shows in the Situations window. The alpha owns its panel, and since 2.38 every other player in the pack sees a copy listing the alpha, the Second, a co-alpha, the Champions and the wolves. A button on the left of the screen, Your Pack , opens the window. Once a year each pack has a 20% chance of a moment with a pack nearby: a scent on the border that ends in a rivalry or a truce, a wolf from the other pack asking to run with yours, two young wolves fighting, two wolves from different packs finding each other, or word of where a hide is. A player alpha is asked when the moment is his to decide, and a moment never moves or wounds a player's character, or makes him a lover, without asking.

docs.x: One wolf can Challenge another he knows to be a wolf if they are rivals, if he has the On The Prowl perk (werewolf tree) or the Challenge perk (hybrid tree), or if they share a pack and his standing is at least 25. To challenge your own alpha you must be the Second, or the Second must have lost to the alpha in the last two years, and you need standing 50. Neither of you can be badly wounded. You can challenge once a year, and the same wolf once every two. A Challenge can be sent to a wolf who will refuse it; refusing costs him 10 standing. An AI wolf refuses a Champion when he has no hide himself, and a fight he would likely lose, unless he is bold or it is his rival. The fight is decided the way every fight between creatures is, both sides in wolf form. Nobody dies of a Challenge. The loser is wounded, loses 10 standing and thinks −10 of the winner for five years. The winner gains 15 standing, as long as the loser stood no more than 10 below him. Beat your alpha and the pack is yours. If the alpha beats his Second, any wolf in the pack at standing 50 may challenge him for the next two years, or until the pack has a new alpha. A co-alpha stays co-alpha only beside the spouse the Unification joined them to. Why an AI wolf challenges. Never for nothing. He challenges his own alpha only when the alpha is too weak to lead or is cruel to the better wolves of the pack. Too weak: he would likely beat him; the alpha is infirm, incapable or blind; the pack holds the alpha 15 standing below him; the alpha is craven; or the hunters know the alpha's name while the challenger still hides. Cruel: the alpha is sadistic, callous, arbitrary, deceitful or a kinslayer, the challenger is none of these, and he has the virtue that stands against it (compassionate, just or honest), or he has come to dislike the alpha, or two of the pack have. Another pack's alpha he takes on only over a feud: a rival, a grudge, or real hatred. Any other wolf he challenges over a feud, or to climb his own pack against a wolf who stands as high and whom he would beat. He picks fights he can win, takes worse odds against a cruel alpha, and never challenges his spouse, lover or friend. When an AI wolf challenges you, he tells you why.

docs.x: The activity header the mod ships for the Werewolf Gathering. An activity for werewolves and hybrids. Any wolf who is a ruler or a landless adventurer can host one, every five years , for the same gold as a camp party. It is held at a county seat in reach, a forest or taiga by preference, with up to 12 guests: werewolves you are close to, your own pack, other alphas you know of, and anyone you know to be in the bite's fever. Hybrids are an optional invitation. Phase Length What happens The Calling 2 weeks The wolves arrive. The Run 3 weeks The host gets a week's event most weeks, from fourteen: a farmer's flock, a hunters' camp, an old wolf, the old stones and more. The run costs the county 1 development and leaves a trail with the host's name on it. The Circle 1 week The fire: the Choosing, Word at the Fire, challenges, pacts and the Unification. Intents. The host can Lead the Pack , Run a Rival's Land (held abroad, everyone who came gains prestige and +5 standing), Seek the Old Ways (a 60% chance to learn of a lost hide that would take him, or where the hide that fits him best is kept) or Hold the Unification . A guest can Earn My Place , Challenge the Alpha (it only comes to a fight for the host's own Second, or any wolf of his pack once the Second has lost to him) or Seek Another Pack . At the fire. A hide that someone has brought and nobody wears has a 60% chance (70% with a player at the fire) to choose the best-fitting wolf there; its holder can let it go or fight for it, though a holder who wins is its Champion only if it would have him. An AI holder never fights a player the hide chose. A guest who came to Seek Another Pack asks to run with the host's pack, and a player host is asked. In Word at the Fire every wolf learns one thing he did not know: where a hide is, that one is lost, or who the True Alpha is. A wolf at standing 50 who learns that someone holds a hide nobody wears gets a claim on it. If Silverback's and Midnight's Champions are both there, they leave as rivals, unless they are married or lovers. At the end every wolf gains Pack Standing , +5 Lycanthropy and, for a Champion, +5 Hide Bond. Wolves of different packs or faiths who shared the fire think +10 of each other for five years. Anyone who came in the bite's fever has been carried: at The Fever Breaks the clean turnings are likelier, death is less likely, and there is a new choice, Let the pack carry me . If he turns, he joins the host's pack, if the host runs one with room. Call the Packs is Alpha's action. For a year its Champion can invite every alpha in reach to a Gathering, known to him or not, and each one who comes owes him a favour if the Gathering ends within that year. It can only be taken when a Gathering could follow: not within five years of his last.

docs.s: The True Alpha, the Unification and the Blood Pact
docs.x: The True Alpha rises at most once in a hundred years, anywhere in the world. He has to be at Pack Standing 100, not the alpha of his pack, never have killed a wolf, and carry at least two of Just, Honest, Compassionate, Brave and Diligent. Each pack rolls 5% a year for its best candidate. When he rises he either takes his pack, and the old alpha thinks well of him for it, or leaves to found his own and takes some of it with him. A True Alpha's pack counts double for its lifestyle bonus, he has Hide Strength even without a hide, and Alpha wants him more than anyone. The Unification joins two packs whose alphas are married to each other. It is held at a Werewolf Gathering under the intent Hold the Unification , needs a third wolf there to stand as elder and the two packs to come to no more than 25 together, and only works if there are no secrets between husband and wife. The packs become one, the spouse becomes co-alpha, and every wolf in it is Evolved : he fights as if in wolf form even when he is not, worth +15 in a fight between creatures and on a hunt. If either alpha is a hybrid, every wolf also gains +10 life expectancy. An AI host never joins a player's pack to his own, and a player whose pack is joined is told. The Blood Pact is sworn at a Gathering when another pack's alpha comes to your fire. Between two rulers it is a real alliance; either way it is +20 opinion both ways for twenty years.

A Champion counts as having Witchcraft's Magical Senses, so a spell cast near him rings. Once a year he can follow the ringing and go after the caster: a fight between the two that never kills, where winning wounds the caster and gives him +5 Hide Bond, and losing wounds him instead. A Champion who practises magic , as a Mage, a True Witch or one born with the Source, regains a great deal of power every year in the Bond, and a Mage among them gains a point of Combat Magic as well. Other wolves get nothing extra. He can raise the Werewolves regiment without the Lycanthropy 50 it normally needs, and can found a pack at any Pack Standing. A known Champion is feared : +15 dread while he carries the Known Werewolf or Known Hybrid trait, +25 for Timber's. Old age does not break him. docs.s: Where the hides are, and how to get one
docs.x: The Supernatural: The Six Hides game rule decides how the game starts: Setting At the start Off No hide is ever created. Lost All six are lost and wake in their own time. Scattered (default) Alpha is lost. One of the other five, chosen at random, goes to an AI werewolf at Lycanthropy 50 or more who fits it, if there is one. The rest are kept in shrines. Awakened Each of the five goes to a fitting AI werewolf where one exists, and to a shrine where none does. Alpha is lost. A shrine is a random holy site of any faith with room for another relic, held by a mortal ruler of a faith that reveres it. The county carries A Relic Kept Here (+1 county opinion), and under a Christian faith the hide is kept as the cloak of Saint Christopher. A hide nobody can place goes to the treasury of the highest-ranked mortal ruler instead. On a save that started before 2.37 the hides are placed at the first new year after the update. Finding out where one is. When a hide goes into a shrine, every player wolf hears of it ( Word Travels ). Wolves also learn where hides are at a Werewolf Gathering's fire, from a passing word between packs, or by seeking the old ways. What a wolf learns he knows for ten years. The hides placed at the start of a game are not announced: those have to be found. Four ways to take a hide out of a shrine: Hold the county, or be its holder's top liege. The game lets either take a relic down from a holy site, and a hide is no different. AI werewolf lords have a decision for it. Siege it. When a siege of the county completes and you are a werewolf or hybrid, or a wolf commands your army there, A Hide in the Shrine lets the wolf take it. The game's own siege looting can get to it first. Make a pilgrimage there. The Relic at [county] offers to walk out with it: an intrigue duel against 25. Fail and you are caught: the county's holder thinks −30 of you for ten years, and you cannot try again anywhere for five. Send for a Hide. A decision for a wolf who knows where a hide is kept. It costs a medium sum of gold, about six months of your income, and word comes back by distance: 45 to 90 days close by, 90 to 180 farther off, and up to a year from across the world. Then you decide whether your man tries to take it, with the same intrigue duel and the same price for failing. A lost hide goes looking. It wakes after 5 to 20 years (Alpha, 15 to 40) and picks a wolf who fits it. If that wolf is a player who rules a county, a great white wolf is seen in his capital ( Something in Your Woods ); hunt it down with a great success and the hide is his. Anyone else simply finds it, in It Came Out of the Trees . A hide does not lie idle. A hide that spends ten years with an AI who is not its Champion (a mortal, a wolf it refused, or a Champion keeping it as a spare) slips away one winter and is lost, to wake again for a wolf it fits. A hunter's trophy, a shrine's relic and a hide a player holds are never taken. There are three more ways into one. At a Werewolf Gathering, a hide nobody wears that someone has brought can choose a wolf at the fire ( The Choosing ). In the bite's fever, Reach for the hide is offered when a hide is close, and always ends in the best turning. And a hunter who kills a Champion is left holding the hide in What the Beast Left , where he can keep it, give it to his liege, give it to his church, or try to burn it.

docs.s: In war and on the hunt
docs.x: A new Champion's wolf is held back. When a war starts that he is part of, The Wolf and the War asks once whether to let it run, hold it back, or stop asking. The decisions Let the Wolf Run and Hold the Wolf Back change it at any time. With the wolf running, he cuts through the enemy's knights on a fixed budget each battle: Champion Picks in a battle Hide Bond under 50 3 Hide Bond 50 to 99 4 Hide Bond 100 5 Midnight's Champion, or a battle in forest or taiga +1 each Under Let It Take Me Doubled Each pick kills an enemy knight whose prowess is no higher than his, with a 50% chance of a second. A hunter riding as a knight on the other side can find him first: one time in four he is wounded and the pick is spent. Every kill reads torn apart in battle , pays the usual prestige for a knight and +2 Hide Bond, and at ten kills he becomes the Wolf if he has no other nickname. Once a battle there is a 25% chance (Timber's, 10%) that the enemy commander works out what he is. Two Champions who are both letting the wolf run meet before anything else. The loser is wounded, or killed if he was already badly wounded or maimed, and his hide goes to the man who killed him. On the hunt. Any wolf at the door can answer Let it out , but for a Champion it is a card the others do not have: the hunter dies without a fight, the hunters who came with him learn what he is, and the card takes ten years to come back (seven at Hide Bond 100). Hunters find a Champion's trail harder to read (−15 on the tracking bar, −10 more for Timber's Champion without a pack), and a hunter who carries a hide himself reads any wolf's better (+10). AI hunters leave a known Champion with his card ready alone unless they mean it: a Monster-Hunter track of 75 and a reason, such as a relative or a trainer the Champion killed, a rivalry or a zealous streak. A hunter who does kill one gets double the prestige and Monster-Hunter experience. Silverback's Stand Over Them puts its Champion's guard on someone in his family or court for five years. If a hunter comes for them, they can call on him, and he fights the hunter in their place.

docs.x: A hybrid is the mod's most powerful creature and its rarest. One is placed in history. None can be born. Every other hybrid has to be made, one character at a time, and at the default settings the turning can kill. Hybrid Known Hybrid Hybrid lifestyle The trait carries +3 intrigue, +2 martial, +2 learning and +18 prowess before any rank, the highest base prowess of anything in the mod, plus immortality, disease immunity, no prowess loss from age, and a fertility penalty. It has three tracks, Vampirism, Lycanthropy and Pack Standing , and unlike the vampire and the werewolf it never renames itself: a hybrid at a full hundred on both tracks still reads "Hybrid" in the interface. The numbers: the two creature tracks, and what a finished hybrid is worth Both tracks have rungs at 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100, and each rung adds 5 per cent to hybrid lifestyle experience. Track At a full 100, cumulative Vampirism +10 intrigue, +2 stewardship, +40 prowess Lycanthropy +5 martial, +3 diplomacy, +20 prowess, +0.10 fertility With the base trait that is 78 prowess , +13 intrigue, +7 martial, +3 diplomacy, +2 learning, +2 stewardship, and half again on lifestyle experience. There is no life expectancy anywhere on the trait, because it does not need one. Making one Two interactions make a hybrid, and both start from a werewolf. A vampire can never become one. Make Hybrid is used by a vampire or a hybrid on a werewolf who already has vampire blood in them, so the sequence is: be a werewolf, be given the blood with Offer Blood , then be turned. The hybrid Ask to be Turned runs the other way: a werewolf asks a vampire or a hybrid, and needs no blood first. A human with no creature trait has two other routes: the ruler designer, and the Become a Hybrid decision, which needs the Supernatural: Embrace Decisions rule set to On. The two turnings are the only place the Supernatural: Confer Death rule is read, and at its default they are dangerous. Make Hybrid starts at 40 live, 60 die , and each point of health above a pivot moves 10 from die to live. The pivot is 4 at the default, 5.5 on More Death and 2.5 on Less Death, so living is the likelier result above health 5, 6.5 and 3.5. Ask to be Turned starts at 50 live, 50 die, with the same pivots. With the rule set to Off , the turning always succeeds. What a hybrid can do A hybrid can do nearly everything both parents can. It shapeshifts. It compels, paying from its own Vampirism track at the same thresholds a vampire pays. It feeds, on its own decision with a seven-year cooldown rather than the werewolf's five, which splits fifty-fifty between the vampire chain and the wolf chain. It claws, though no AI hybrid ever will, because the AI side of both claw interactions requires the plain werewolf trait. It regenerates: the cleanups that strip disfigurement and the traits of old age run on vampires and hybrids. Among werewolves only a hide's Champion gets them. Like vampires, demons and witches, a hybrid cannot be compelled . Werewolves can be, at a cost ( Compulsion ). In a hunt a hybrid carries +10 on its own account, and the game reads whichever of its two tracks is higher when it prices the fight, the lord's investigation and the prestige for the kill. If it dies shifted, the body reads as a werewolf; otherwise it reads as a vampire. The mod never gives a hybrid a death of its own: in the old confrontation chain it dies as one or the other on a coin flip. Hides and packs Packs and the Six Hides work for a hybrid as they do for a werewolf. The pivot is 4 at the default, 5.5 on More Death and 2.5 on Less Death, so living is the likelier result above health 5, 6.5 and 3.5. Ask to be Turned starts at 50 live, 50 die, with the same pivots. With the rule set to Off , the turning always succeeds.

docs.x: A hybrid can do nearly everything both parents can. It shapeshifts. It compels, paying from its own Vampirism track at the same thresholds a vampire pays. It feeds, on its own decision with a seven-year cooldown rather than the werewolf's five, which splits fifty-fifty between the vampire chain and the wolf chain. It claws, though no AI hybrid ever will, because the AI side of both claw interactions requires the plain werewolf trait. It regenerates: the cleanups that strip disfigurement and the traits of old age run on vampires and hybrids. Among werewolves only a hide's Champion gets them. Like vampires, demons and witches, a hybrid cannot be compelled . Werewolves can be, at a cost ( Compulsion ). In a hunt a hybrid carries +10 on its own account, and the game reads whichever of its two tracks is higher when it prices the fight, the lord's investigation and the prestige for the kill. If it dies shifted, the body reads as a werewolf; otherwise it reads as a vampire. The mod never gives a hybrid a death of its own: in the old confrontation chain it dies as one or the other on a coin flip.

docs.t: Supernatural CK3 Mod Wiki: Vampires, Werewolves and the Hunt
docs.x: Packs and the Six Hides work for a hybrid as they do for a werewolf. These are the differences: A hybrid Champion does not age , so he also gets Ageless Wolf : +20% werewolf and hybrid lifestyle experience ( What a Champion gets ). A hybrid counts ×1.6 in a fight between creatures ( Hide Strength ). The Challenge and Pack Leader perks are in the hybrid's Lycanthropy tree. Challenge lets him Challenge any wolf he knows; Pack Leader lets him found a pack at Pack Standing 40. A werewolf who becomes a hybrid keeps his Pack Standing. A hybrid alpha in a Unification gives every wolf of the joined pack +10 life expectancy ( The Unification ). Hybrids are an optional invitation to a Werewolf Gathering .

Finishing it takes roughly 27,000 lifestyle experience and two full tracks. Lycanthropy is the slower of the two tracks to fill.

docs.x: The magic in Supernatural is Rycie's Witchcraft mod, shipped inside Supernatural in full, with Supernatural's own layer added on top of it: a hunter who can walk that world, a witch hunt that can find a coven, and a set of fixes where the two meet. That is why the witch layer is so much larger than everything else here, and why so much of it behaves differently from the creatures. Because Witchcraft ships inside Supernatural, running both at once is the one incompatibility that matters . See what not to run alongside it . Witch True Witch Mage Legendary Mage Warlock Source Yaga Grand Master What a witch is Unlike a vampire or a werewolf, a witch has no single trait with a track that counts up. Magic is spread across a family of traits, and you climb through the lifestyle rather than through the trait: Trait What it is Witch The base trait. −1 diplomacy, +1 intrigue, +1 learning, +10% magic lifestyle experience, +20 opinion from other witches. It is the thing every faith doctrine, every scheme and every gate keys off. True Witch The Witchery tree's capstone trait. +3 intrigue, +10 baseline dread, half again on diplomatic range, and it unlocks the Search for Magical Artifacts . It can never sit on a hunter. Mage The Arcane capstone, renamed Legendary Mage at a full Secret Knowledge track. It has five tracks of its own, and almost everything a mage can do runs through them. The Mage and its five tracks. Warlock The Black Magic capstone. +3 intrigue, +10 baseline dread, +1.5 health, −5% army upkeep, −5 opinion from everyone. Source Genetic magical potential, and the only inheritable one that matters, and one child in a hundred is born with it. It has a Magic Potential track that pays life expectancy and fertility, and from 20 restores some stored power once a year, and an Instability track that charges for it in stress and health. Yaga Baba Yaga's own trait: immortal, +10 health, +40% magic lifestyle experience, +50 baseline dread. It can only be taken while no Yaga is alive and you hold her hut: by a True Witch who has visited it, with Claim the Yaga title , or by a mage who breaks in on a Research Expedition . There is also a female-line version of Source called Yaga's Blood, which passes from mother to daughter at a 90 per cent chance, and a Grand Master of the Coven trait with an Authority track. Becoming one The route is a scheme, Convert to Witchcraft , run by a witch on a target who does not already have the trait. It is secret, it takes a while, and its success turns on the target's opinion of you, their zeal and your learning. A zealous target resists, unless their rite both reveres witches and accepts witchcraft, which turns zeal in your favour. Attraction helps, up to +30. Being a coven house is worth +20. Mystics, revelers, herbalists, seducers and the excommunicated are all easier marks. Witches do not inherit the trait. What inherits is Source, Yaga's Blood and possession. The mod's history makes only two witches, both Mikaelsons: Esther and Freja. The magic history file holds one character, a demon who dies in 809, before the earliest bookmark. Every other witch you meet in a campaign was made at runtime. Twenty-one perks across the three, three capstones, three traits. They are not equally open, and each has its own focus: Tree Who can climb it Capstone What the path gives you Witchery , 8 perks The first three perks need only the witch trait or the secret. The rest, short of the capstone, need the Witchcraft focus or the True Witch trait, and Mystical Insight

docs.s: The lifestyle and its three trees
docs.x: The Magic lifestyle is tied with the Demonic for the cheapest in the mod, and it holds three trees, Witchery , Arcane and Black Magic , where the vampire, werewolf and demon lifestyles hold one each and the hunter and hybrid two. Twenty-one perks across the three, three capstones, three traits. They are not equally open, and each has its own focus: Tree Who can climb it Capstone What the path gives you Witchery , 8 perks The first three perks need only the witch trait or the secret. The rest, short of the capstone, need the Witchcraft focus or the True Witch trait, and Mystical Insight needs the focus itself. True Witch An amulet, a familiar (dog, cat, rat, horse or bird), Use Scrying, an extra nature trait, +20 opinion from admirers, passive magic detection Arcane , 7 perks The Arcane focus, or already being a Mage. A plain witch cannot take that focus: she also needs a magic artifact (the Enchanted Ring and an awakened Singularity count), the Source, the Magical Experiments perk, a place of power held while landed, a Gnostic Council grant, Research Cooperation from a summit, a house with the academy, an event that opens it, or, as a True Witch, an academy standing anywhere in the world. Mage Counter-spells, Create Potion, Power Strike and Aura Enhancement, Perform Magic Ritual, then the Mage trait Black Magic , 6 perks The Black Magic focus, which any witch can take, as can a True Witch, anyone holding a magic artifact or the Source, and anyone with Magical Experiments. Warlock Cast a Curse, then Cast Powerful Curse, Domination, a life-extending ritual, and Summon Demon The Arcane tree's root perk, Magical Experiments , is a gamble. Four times in five it is +1 learning. The other fifth it leaves you disfigured, wounded, one-eyed or one-legged, and an injury you already carry drops out of the roll, so the odds tilt further toward learning. Do not take it if an event has already made you a Mage: for anyone but the mod's special characters it removes the Mage trait. A hunter cannot take any of the three capstones. That block is explicit and it shows you why in the tooltip. Before it existed, a hunter could buy the perk, the trait would silently fail to attach, and the perk point was gone. One capstone. Since 2.38 a character holds one of the three. The Mage, Warlock and True Witch perks each refuse anyone who already has another of the capstone traits, with the tooltip You already walk another path (a False Mage is the exception; see Known issues ). The other perks of all three trees stay open. Characters who held two or three before 2.38 keep them. Witchcraft's own ways of handing out a capstone (an AI taught sorcery, the Magic Catalyst, Enchanted Blood, a mythical legend, and the events that make Mages and True Witches) pass over anyone already on another path, and Travel To Another World teaches such a character teleportation instead. Each capstone clears your focus when you take it. Every perk in all three trees, with its numbers, is in the perk reference . The Magic lifestyle is open to anyone with the Mage or True Witch trait as well as to witches. The AI's nature now weighs on its focus, on top of Witchcraft's own leanings: Arcane suits the just, compassionate, honest, patient, diligent and ambitious; Black Magic the arbitrary, vengeful, wrathful, deceitful and callous; Witchcraft the content, gregarious and trusting. One fitting trait doubles the weight and two or more make it four times; an opposed trait halves it. A player chooses freely.

docs.s: The Mage and its five tracks
docs.x: The Mage trait comes from the Arcane tree's last perk. On its own it is modest: +1 learning, +1 intrigue, half a prestige a month, and the Teach Sorcery and Mage Duel interactions. What makes it the strongest thing in the craft is its five tracks, which fill as you use magic and unlock most of what a mage can do. At 100 Secret Knowledge the trait renames itself Legendary Mage . Most mage content checks for a true mage: someone with the trait who is not secretly a False Mage . Track How it fills What each rung gives Secret Knowledge +1 for casting any of fifteen spells, and from research, summits, triangulation and duels. 25 : +3 learning, and with the Counter-spells perk you can spend power to counter a spell. 50 : +3 learning, +5 power from every standard gain, and Magic Triangulation shows the artifact you choose. 75 : +3 learning, +10 hostile scheme success, Cast the Ultimate Spell . 100 : +3 learning, your spells cannot be detected, a legend seed of your own, and the Legendary Mage name. Each rung also adds +2 starting progress to Magical Research . Combat Magic +1 per Power Strike, Fire Storm or Tornado, and from duels, Esoteric Training and research. 35 : +5 advantage, +25% fatal casualties for the enemy, and one free Magic Shield in every duel. 65 : +5 advantage, −25% siege phase time, the Shadow element. 100 : +5 advantage, +20 travel safety, the Fire element. Demonology 4 per gain, 6 while you hold Houska Castle. Summoning, events, research. 35 : summoning no longer costs stress, and a binding goes wrong 3 times in 100 instead of 30. 65 : +2 diplomacy, +2 learning. 100 : the Banish Demon spell, and you can summon demons by type or by name. Alchemy 4 per gain. Potions, events, research. 30 : +1 gold a month, +0.5 health-penalty negation, Create Potion at half price. 70 : +3 gold a month, +5 life expectancy, Create Potion every three years instead of four. 100 : +5 life expectancy, the Magic Transmutation Spell, and you choose what Create Potion brews. Power Saturation The mage's store of power. The only track that falls as well as rises. 10 : +0.2 health, +1 Power, Fire and Kinetic in duels. 50 : +1 Power and Fire, +5 travel safety. 100 : +1 Power, +5 prowess, +5 advantage. Power does not refill on its own. There is no monthly trickle. It comes from acts: Perform Magic Ritual (the Arcane tree's The Ritual perk, every five months), Mana Siphon, Consume, Feed the Darkblade, a Magic potion, and dozens of events. A standard gain is 10, plus 5 at Secret Knowledge 50, plus 5 for each kind of place of power you hold (15 at most), plus 5 or 10 at high Magic Potential, and more for a Greedy for Power mage, an equipped catalyst and a few others. It stops at 100. The Source is the one exception: from Magic Potential 20 it restores some power once a year. Spells cost 5, 10 or 20, and you need at least 10 to cast a standard spell and 20 for a large one. Someone who is not a mage stores power as a modifier instead of a track. The False Mage # Some characters carry the Mage trait without the power: a secret, False Mage , says they are pretending. A False Mage shows the trait but fails the true-mage check that most mage content uses: no Magical Research, no Teach Sorcery, no research spells, no mage contracts. A few things look only at the trait, among them Mage Duel and a Gnostic Council appointment. A player can choose to become one when an event offers it; one True Witch in ten is offered it six months to three years after the capstone; and two in ten court mages the game generates are frauds. Exposure strips the Mage trait, costs a prestige level and five years of Liar Liar , and a liege who employed them as court mage holds it against them for ten years. Taking the Magical Experiments perk ends the pretence the other way: the secret

docs.x: There are 54 magic interactions , most of them spells, and almost none costs gold, piety or prestige : Recall from the Gnostic Council can cost 5,000 prestige, and a refused Mana Siphon or cyrograph costs prestige. The price of a spell is its cooldown, its stress, its power, and the risk of what the target does with it. Since 2.38, 27 of them, the friendly and diplomatic ones, sit in the Supernatural menu beside the mod's own interactions. Curses and attacks stay under Hostile, and the witch trial under Prison. Three things can happen to a spell you cast. It can be countered , by a mage who took Counter-spells, or by a court mage protecting his liege's household. It can be stopped outright by an antimagic seal . Or, if the target is a Mage, a demon or Yaga, it can be deflected into a mage duel , which is a different event entirely and not one you chose to start. You also cannot cast while you are already duelling. The spells themselves run from a curse and a domination at the low end through healing, power strikes, aura enhancement, mind scanning and shadow steps, up to plague, firestorm, tornado, earthquake and teleportation at the far end of the mage tracks. Cooldowns vary widely and are the main limit: Power Strike is a day, Domination is a week, Hypercognition is eight years , and an Earthquake cannot be aimed at the same person twice inside twenty. A mage learns spells four ways. The Learn new spell decision needs a true mage holding a county with the Academy of Magic, runs every fifteen years, gives +2 Secret Knowledge, and draws one spell you do not know: Bless the Land, Healing, Shadow Step, Plague, Hypercognition, Aura Reading and Thorn Walls are equally likely, Teleportation a little less, Fire Storm rarely. A mage can Teach Spells to another mage every ten years. Magical Research can end in a new spell. And the Arcane tree's Caster perk gives Power Strike and Aura Enhancement outright, and a character who is not yet a Mage also gets the choice of a third spell or another benefit. docs.x: There is no brewing screen. Potions are artifacts in your inventory with a hidden marker, and there are eleven of them. You brew with the Create Potion decision, which needs either the witch trait plus Herbalist, or the Advanced Alchemy perk, and, as of 2.34, the hunter tree's Combat Spells perk, which is Supernatural's own addition reaching into the Witchcraft layer. It costs gold by your highest title: 10 for a baron or someone landless, 20 for a count, 40 for a duke, 100 for a king and 150 for an emperor, all halved at Alchemy 30. The cooldown is four years, three at Alchemy 70. Create Potion is a menu, and most of it is not potions. It offers a Poison, a Love Potion or a Health Elixir, each a three-year modifier on you rather than something in your inventory. Only a Mage or a True Witch gets the fourth choice, I will experiment , which makes one of the potion artifacts seven times in ten; a brewer who is both a herbalist and has Advanced Alchemy never fails it. So a witch-herbalist or a hunter can brew, but never one of the eleven potions. The experiment rolls Regeneration, Magic, Mutagen, Unknown, Youth, Charisma, Might, Learning or Fertility; Mind-Reading only for a Mage or Yaga; and Liquid Aether, a crafting reagent rather than a drink, only for a true mage. At Alchemy 100 a Mage chooses the potion outright. The player drinks through a self-targeted interaction with a one-day cooldown. The ten separate drink decisions in the files are all AI-only and you will never see them. Two worth knowing before you drink them. Regeneration clears thirty-eight different afflictions in one go, from leprosy and the pox through blindness, maiming and disfigurement, and it also takes away New Eyes , if you have it. Mutagen is a real gamble: one time in ten you come out Herculean and clean, most of the time you trade fertility for muscle, and one time in twenty it leaves you weak, infertile and disfigured.
